title: Energy, Work and Power Module 4 Lesson 2: Power Acceleration Steady Speed Slope custom practice

evidence_basis.originality_note: All prompts, numerical values and physical configurations are original; mapped Cambridge past-paper evidence informs cognitive demand and assessment structure only.

parts.prompt: A car of mass $1200\text{ kg}$ ascends a hill inclined at an angle $\theta$ to the horizontal, where $\sin\theta = 0.05$, at a constant speed of $20\text{ m s}^{-1}$. The resistance to motion is $700\text{ N}$. Calculate, in $\text{kW}$, the power of the car's engine. Take $g = 10\text{ m s}^{-2}$.

A van of mass $2000\text{ kg}$ is travelling up a slope inclined at $\alpha$ to the horizontal, where $\sin\alpha = 0.04$. The engine develops a power of $48\text{ kW}$ and the resistance to motion is $800\text{ N}$. Find the acceleration of the van when its speed is $16\text{ m s}^{-1}$. Take $g = 10\text{ m s}^{-2}$.

A truck of mass $5000\text{ kg}$ descends a slope inclined at angle $\beta$ to the horizontal, where $\sin\beta = 0.03$, with its engine working at $15\text{ kW}$. The resistance to motion is $2500\text{ N}$. Find the constant speed of the truck. Take $g = 10\text{ m s}^{-2}$.

A lorry of mass $10000\text{ kg}$ climbs a slope inclined at $\theta$ where $\sin\theta = 0.06$. The engine develops $50\text{ kW}$ and the resistance to motion is $2000\text{ N}$. Find the deceleration of the lorry at an instant when its speed is $10\text{ m s}^{-1}$. Take $g = 10\text{ m s}^{-2}$.

A car of mass $1500\text{ kg}$ climbs a hill of inclination $\alpha$ where $\sin\alpha = 0.08$. The engine operates at a maximum power of $60\text{ kW}$ against a constant resistance of $800\text{ N}$. Find the maximum steady speed the car can maintain up the hill. Take $g = 10\text{ m s}^{-2}$.

A car of mass $1000\text{ kg}$ moves down a hill inclined at $3^\circ$ to the horizontal. The resistance to motion is $500\text{ N}$. Calculate the power of the engine in $\text{kW}$ required for the car to accelerate at $0.8\text{ m s}^{-2}$ at an instant when its speed is $20\text{ m s}^{-1}$. Take $g = 10\text{ m s}^{-2}$.

questions.prompt: A car of mass $1250\text{ kg}$ travels up a hill inclined at an angle $\theta$ to the horizontal, where $\sin\theta = 0.04$. There is a constant resistance to motion of $750\text{ N}$.

parts.label: (a)
parts.prompt: The engine operates at a power of $35\text{ kW}$. Find the acceleration of the car at the instant when its speed is $14\text{ m s}^{-1}$. Take $g = 10\text{ m s}^{-2}$.

parts.label: (b)
parts.prompt: Find the maximum steady speed the car can maintain up this hill with the engine working at $35\text{ kW}$.

questions.prompt: A cyclist and his bicycle have a combined mass of $80\text{ kg}$. The cyclist exerts a constant power of $240\text{ W}$ while riding up a slope inclined at $2^\circ$ to the horizontal against a constant resistance of $25\text{ N}$. Take $g = 10\text{ m s}^{-2}$.

parts.label: (a)
parts.prompt: Find the driving force exerted by the cyclist when his speed is $4\text{ m s}^{-1}$, and determine his acceleration at this instant.

parts.label: (b)
parts.prompt: Find the steady speed that the cyclist can maintain up this slope when working at $240\text{ W}$.

questions.prompt: A tractor of mass $4000\text{ kg}$ travels along a straight horizontal road at a steady speed of $15\text{ m s}^{-1}$ against a constant resistance of $1200\text{ N}$. Take $g = 10\text{ m s}^{-2}$.

parts.label: (a)
parts.prompt: Calculate the power output of the tractor's engine in $\text{kW}$.

parts.label: (b)
parts.prompt: The tractor reaches the base of a hill inclined at an angle $\theta$ to the horizontal, where $\sin\theta = 0.05$. The engine power is increased to $36\text{ kW}$ and the resistance to motion remains $1200\text{ N}$. Find the initial acceleration of the tractor as it enters the hill at $15\text{ m s}^{-1}$, and find the maximum constant speed it can maintain up the hill.

questions.prompt: A train of mass $180000\text{ kg}$ travels up a track inclined at an angle of $3^\circ$ to the horizontal. A constant resistance of $15000\text{ N}$ opposes the motion of the train. Take $g = 10\text{ m s}^{-2}$.

parts.label: (a)
parts.prompt: At an instant when the speed of the train is $12\text{ m s}^{-1}$, its deceleration is $0.15\text{ m s}^{-2}$. Find the driving force exerted by the engine and the power of the train's engine in $\text{kW}$.

parts.label: (b)
parts.prompt: The train's engine is now throttled up to a continuous power of $1600\text{ kW}$. Find the steady speed the train can maintain up this incline.

questions.prompt: A car of mass $1200\text{ kg}$ travels on a straight road inclined at an angle $\alpha$ to the horizontal, where $\sin\alpha = 0.05$. The resistance to motion is constant and equal to $800\text{ N}$ whether travelling uphill or downhill. Take $g = 10\text{ m s}^{-2}$.

parts.label: (a)
parts.prompt: The car climbs the hill at a constant speed of $24\text{ m s}^{-1}$. Calculate the power developed by the engine in $\text{kW}$.

parts.label: (b)
parts.prompt: The car now descends the same hill with the engine working at the same power of $33.6\text{ kW}$. Find the acceleration of the car at the instant when its speed is $24\text{ m s}^{-1}$, and determine the maximum steady speed the car can achieve down the hill.

questions.prompt: A truck of mass $4000\text{ kg}$ is towing a trailer of mass $2000\text{ kg}$ up a hill inclined at an angle $\theta$ to the horizontal, where $\sin\theta = 0.06$. The truck and trailer are connected by a light rigid towbar parallel to the slope. The resistance to motion is $800\text{ N}$ on the truck and $400\text{ N}$ on the trailer. Take $g = 10\text{ m s}^{-2}$.

parts.label: (a)
parts.prompt: The engine develops a power of $72\text{ kW}$. Find the acceleration of the truck and trailer, and the tension in the towbar, at an instant when their speed is $12\text{ m s}^{-1}$.

parts.label: (b)
parts.prompt: The speed reaches a constant maximum value $V$ while the engine continues to work at $72\text{ kW}$. Calculate $V$, find the new tension in the towbar at this maximum speed, and state the ratio of the trailer tension at maximum speed to that when accelerating at $12\text{ m s}^{-1}$.

questions.prompt: A car of mass $1000\text{ kg}$ travels along a straight road over a mountain pass. The climb consists of an uphill section $AB$ inclined at $\theta$ where $\sin\theta = 0.05$, followed by a crest at $B$, and a downhill section $BC$ inclined at the same angle $\theta$. The resistance to motion is constant at $900\text{ N}$ throughout. The car's engine works at a constant power of $42\text{ kW}$ on both sections. Take $g = 10\text{ m s}^{-2}$.

parts.label: (a)
parts.prompt: Find the maximum steady speed $V_1$ the car can maintain up the section $AB$, and calculate the acceleration of the car on $AB$ at an instant when its speed is $20\text{ m s}^{-1}$.

parts.label: (b)
parts.prompt: As the car crests the pass and begins to descend $BC$ at a speed of $30\text{ m s}^{-1}$, find its initial acceleration down the hill, and determine the maximum steady speed $V_2$ the car can maintain down $BC$ under the same engine power of $42\text{ kW}$.
